items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: Kid Punch... Kid Punch played wonderful. Played wonderful plenty. He used to play Pelican Club... Then later on I saw him on Chicago and all.

ctx.x: Yeah, he and Kid Punch got together after all those.
Kid Punch... Kid Punch played wonderful. Played wonderful plenty. He used to play Pelican Club on all... Mm-hmm. On South Ramp off street. Yeah. Then later on I saw him on Chicago and all.
